# pefftacular

> Pure-Python, zero-dependency library for reading and writing PEFF (PSI Extended FASTA
> Format) files: FASTA plus structured per-entry proteomics annotations (variants,
> UniMod/PSI-MOD modifications, processed forms, disulfide bonds, proteoforms, custom keys).

Read a whole file with `read_peff(path)` → `(FileHeader, list[SequenceEntry])`, or stream
with `with PeffReader(path) as r: r.header; for entry in r: ...`. Paths may be gzip/bzip2/xz
compressed. Write with `write_peff(header, entries, dest, *, verify=True)`
(`verify=False` skips the read-back check for unchanged entries).
`SequenceEntry.from_fasta(header, sequence)` / `entry.to_fasta()` convert to and from plain
FASTA (UniProt-style header strings), and `entry.to_proforma(mods="psimod"|"unimod",
variants=...)` renders a ProForma 2.0 string. `to_records(path)` returns flat dicts
for `pandas.DataFrame(...)` / `polars.DataFrame(...)` (neither is a dependency). All models are frozen dataclasses importable from the
package root (`SequenceEntry` is not hashable: it holds dicts). `PeffReader` must be used
in a `with` block. Parsing is permissive: spec violations are reported as `PeffWarning`
(`warnings.simplefilter("error", PeffWarning)` for strict mode); structural failures raise
`PeffParseError` with `.line`, `.context` and `.hint`. Requires Python 3.12+.

Part of tacular-omics; sibling `fastatacular` handles plain FASTA with the same API shape.

## Docs

- [llms-full.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tacular-omics/pefftacular/main/llms-full.txt): self-contained usage guide with every public name, signatures, examples and gotchas
- [README](https://github.com/tacular-omics/pefftacular/blob/main/README.md): install, quick start, data model, error handling
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/tacular-omics/pefftacular/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): release history

## API

- [Public API (`__init__.py`)](https://github.com/tacular-omics/pefftacular/blob/main/src/pefftacular/__init__.py): the exported names
- [Models](https://github.com/tacular-omics/pefftacular/blob/main/src/pefftacular/_models.py): FileHeader, DatabaseHeader, SequenceEntry and annotation dataclasses
- [Errors and warnings](https://github.com/tacular-omics/pefftacular/blob/main/src/pefftacular/errors.py): PeffError, PeffParseError, PeffWriteError, PeffWarning

## Optional

- [PEFF 1.0 specification (PDF)](https://github.com/tacular-omics/pefftacular/blob/main/PEFF_SpecDoc_1.0_FINAL.pdf): the authoritative format spec
- [PSI PEFF page](https://www.psidev.info/peff): HUPO-PSI format home
- [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/tacular-omics/pefftacular/blob/main/CLAUDE.md): contributor guide for coding agents
- [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/pefftacular/): package page
- [fastatacular](https://github.com/tacular-omics/fastatacular): plain-FASTA sibling library
